sentences: Algorithmic secret-key agreement studies parties holding correlated strings who communicate to obtain a shared key hidden from an observer.
The saved question concerns the amount of communication required for that agreement.
The difficulty is to exploit common information while ensuring that the public transcript does not reveal the key itself.
A sharp bound would connect individual-string information profiles with the operational cost of secure coordination.
